summary: run_subprocess_popen uses io.popen on a shell-escaped string; additional_flags tokenized by whitespace before escaping, so spaces in flag values split across arguments
Two subprocess execution paths: run_subprocess (argv array via utils.subprocess, safe) and run_subprocess_popen (shell string via io.popen, used for progress display)
seconds_to_time_string returns 'unknown' for negative seconds; full=true forces hours component
shell_escape quotes individual argv tokens using single-quotes (POSIX) or double-quotes (Windows); on Windows wraps entire concatenated string in an extra pair of double-quotes
expand_properties supports conditional templates: ${?prop:val}, ${!prop:val}, ${?prop==compare:val}, ${=prop} for raw value
run_subprocess_popen appends '2>&1' to the shell command string, redirecting stderr to stdout for progress parsing
